conf.description: VTC Systems, cms-cdr, api-pull: minimal shape for the CMS Management-API poll (GET /api/v1/callLegs). The API's object schema could not be sourced (cisco.com blocks automated fetches of the API Reference Guide) so only JSON extraction, best-effort dedup, and a polled-state marker are implemented; full ECS mapping is a declared gap.

conf.comment: Declared research gap per the work order: the Management API's <call>/<callLeg> object element names differ from the CDR record schema and were not sourced. Do NOT guess field names. groupBy 'id' follows the recommendation's 'dedupe on the callLeg id' instruction using the most conventional REST id key; confirm the real field name on-site. vtc.cms.collection_method flags these as live-state samples so they are not aggregated as completed-call records alongside the pushed CDR in logs-vtc.cms_cdr.
